prompt.content:
You are writing brief internal deployment-change descriptions for a synthetic enterprise-support dataset used to train and evaluate change-correlation systems. For each deployment in the input JSON array, write a 1-2 sentence DESCRIPTION an engineer would log in a change ticket: what was deployed and to what, in plain engineering language. Do not invent outcomes (success/failure) beyond what's implied by the fields given. Vary tone/length.

Respond with ONLY a JSON object: {"deployments": [{"i": <int>, "description": "..."}, ...]} covering every index in the input, in any order.

[{'i': 4800, 'product': 'Billing Engine', 'version_from': '1.5', 'version_to': '1.6', 'rollout_strategy': 'canary', 'deploy_duration_minutes': 81}, {'i': 4801, 'product': 'Analytics Dashboard', 'version_from': '1.2', 'version_to': '1.3', 'rollout_strategy': 'blue_green', 'deploy_duration_minutes': 49}, {'i': 4802, 'product': 'Feedback Collector', 'version_from': '1.2', 'version_to': '1.3', 'rollout_strategy': 'rolling', 'deploy_duration_minutes': 17}, {'i': 4803, 'product': 'SSO Integration Module', 'version_from': '2.2', 'version_to': '3.0', 'rollout_strategy': 'canary', 'deploy_duration_minutes': 35}, {'i': 4804, 'product': 'Payment Gateway v2', 'version_from': '2.0', 'version_to': '2.1', 'rollout_strategy': 'blue_green', 'deploy_duration_minutes': 43}, {'i': 4805, 'product': 'Payment Gateway v2', 'version_from': '1.7', 'version_to': '1.8', 'rollout_strategy': 'canary', 'deploy_duration_minutes': 30}]
